name: National public administration data centre (Centre de données de l'administration publique)
developer: Government of the Union of the Comoros via ANADEN (Agence Nationale de Développement du Numérique) and Comores Câble; supported by African Development Bank (AfDB) funding (~EUR 9.51M, 2024)
notes: Tier 3 national data centre, hosting capacity 44.4 Tbps, co-managed by ANADEN and Comores Câble; inaugurated/commissioned 19 May 2025 (announced by Comorian authorities on 14 May 2025); part of 'Comores Numérique 2028' strategy; AfDB approved ~EUR 9.51M ($10.5M) in 2024 under the Projet d'appui à la digitalisation de l'économie comorienne to build/operate the data centre and enhance existing infrastructure. Exact facility location not stated in sources; national digital infrastructure is centred on Moroni (capital), Grande Comore. No capacity in MW disclosed.

No public datacenter/data center/server farm project found in targeted searches for Anjouan (Nzwani). Comoros data centre activity is a single national public-administration facility on Grande Comore (Moroni region); Anjouan searches returned only tourism/general island content.

No public datacenter/data center/server farm project found in targeted searches for Moheli (Mwali). Comoros data centre activity is a single national public-administration facility on Grande Comore (Moroni region); no datacenter development identified on Moheli.
